steps.label: Candidates register
steps.quote: Candidates register with the Federal Election Commission to run for president.

steps.label: presidential primaries and caucuses
steps.quote: States and parties hold presidential primaries and caucuses.

steps.label: nominating conventions
steps.quote: Parties hold nominating conventions to choose their presidential candidates.

steps.label: Election Day
steps.quote: Election Day is the first Tuesday after the first Monday.

steps.label: Electoral College
steps.quote: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College.
